text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see, I was doing a bit of... 
research..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...Right before going to sleep, 
I heard a bird call I didn't recognize."
choice_data_list: A bird call even you didn't know...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Yes... And so I simply had to know 
what kind of bird it was, I couldn't stop 
wondering... 
I looked into it for quite a while, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"...In the end, I never found out. 
Just what could it have been...?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Daring Tact wasn't able to get 
much rest...
